items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: A theme provider and toggle button that switch between light and dark with an animated circular reveal. The provider applies the `dark` class to the html element and stores the choice; the button cross-fades a sun and moon icon.
items.author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
items.docs: Wrap your app in <ThemeProvider> inside the root layout's <body>, and add suppressHydrationWarning to <html>. Your CSS needs a dark variant that matches the class, e.g. `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))` on Tailwind v4. The reveal runs at 300ms and is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: theme-picker
items.title: Theme Picker
items.description: A row of swatches that switches the accent colour theme at runtime: emerald, slate, azure, violet and amber. Each theme overrides the primary, ring and primary-ink tokens in light and dark, and the choice is stored and applied before first paint.
items.author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
items.docs: Pass the themes to the provider from @spaceman/theme-toggle: `<ThemeProvider colorThemes={colorThemes} defaultColorTheme="emerald">`, importing colorThemes from the installed themes.ts. The provider puts a `theme-<name>` class on <html>; the CSS this item adds maps each class to its accent tokens.

items.description: An icon button that copies a value and confirms with a check that cross-fades in place of the copy icon. A polite live region announces the copy.
